Database migrations with goose: on each generation, the change in the model since the last one becomes a migration file of yours in migrations/, which the migrate command (task migrate) applies.

```esquadro
blueprint migrations
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [postgres](../postgres/): the app must use them too.

## Hooks

- `pre-gen` write

## Go modules

- `github.com/pressly/goose/v3` v3.24.1
